test_results.observation: PDF submission streamed an immutable Workspace-scoped source object, persisted a queued job and returned the durable HTTP 202 contract without invoking downstream processing.
Source version and current pointer committed atomically; controlled object-identity conflict rolled back both, and ownership constraints rejected invalid pointer assignment and hard deletion.
Exact request replay converged without duplicate durable state, changed request fingerprints conflicted without mutation, and authorization remained Workspace-scoped.
Raw PDF source identity remained separate from configuration-based derivation identity; changed configuration reused the source version while changed raw bytes created a distinct version.
Concurrent duplicate submissions converged to one durable identity and competing changed-byte versions serialized with unique sequential versions and one current pointer.
Authentication and Workspace authorization ran before storage, and database constraints rejected cross-owner current pointers and deletion of referenced resources.
Milestone 1 synchronous CLI and HTTP ingestion remained green alongside the new PDF submission path.
evidence: focused Issue #15 and CLI suite: 36 passed
